## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `aws-sqs-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the AWS Console

1. <!-- manual: Access the [AWS Management Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/). -->

## Step 3: Create an IAM user

1. <!-- manual: In the AWS Management Console, search for IAM in the services search bar and select it. -->
2. Select **Users** in the left navigation pane.
3. Select **Create user**.
4. Enter a suitable **User name** and select **Next**.
5. <!-- manual: Enter a suitable User name and select Next. -->
6. Set permissions by adding the user to a group, copying permissions, or attaching policies directly (for example, **AmazonSQSFullAccess**). Select **Next**.
7. Review the details and select **Create user**.
8. <!-- manual: Review the details -->

## Step 4: Get the access key ID and secret access key

1. <!-- manual: Select the user you just created from the Users list. -->
2. Go to the **Security credentials** tab and select **Create access key**.
3. Select your use case and select **Next**.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the Access key ID and Secret access key. Use these credentials to authenticate your integration with Amazon SQS. -->
